summary.name: Apache HTTP Server
summary.one_liner: Apache HTTP Server is an open source web server (httpd) that provides HTTP services; this page is a raw SVN trunk directory listing of its source tree.
use_cases: Browse the Apache httpd source tree
Build Apache HTTP Server from source
Find build files for Windows or Unix
Study httpd module and server code
summary.what_it_does: The page is a directory listing of the Apache httpd trunk in the ASF Subversion repository. It shows top-level files and folders such as server/, modules/, include/, os/, srclib/, docs/, support/, and test/. It includes build-related files including configure.in, buildconf, CMakeLists.txt, Makefile.in, Makefile.win, and Visual Studio .dsp/.dsw project files. The listing also includes README, INSTALL, CHANGES, LICENSE, and SECURITY.md files. The listing itself does not describe features beyond the file names.
notable: Official Apache Software Foundation Subversion repository for httpd trunk
Includes both autoconf (configure.in, buildconf) and CMake build paths
Contains Windows Visual Studio project files (.dsp/.dsw)
caveats: Page is a raw source directory listing, not a product page with feature documentation
Trunk is the development branch and may be unstable
